title: DeMeco Ryans: History doesn't matter, the 2026 Texans have to play good football

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: DeMeco Ryans: History doesn't matter, the 2026 Texans have to play good football
sources.description: No team wants to start a season 0-2, but the Texans would seem to be the likeliest team in the league to shrug off a sluggish start to the year.
